attributes.action: Save the DARTMOOR PONIES from unnecessary culling.
attributes.additional_details: Signing this petition may help save these poor animals from being killed, they do not deserve this whatsoever, Starmer says he is doing this because “they are a waste of space”. This is terrible behaviour, and especially with the state of our world at the moment we do not need more destruction of  nature or disregard of living beings. These ponies belong here. Choose compassion, and act now to stop this cruel and unnecessary cull.
attributes.background: Why are you killing these innocent creatures? This world isn’t only for humans, what about nature. These animals were here far before us, and killing them for such a pathetic reason is very unnecessary and disgusting. “Using too much grasslands”. They are animals, not pests, they belong here.
